integrity: The stated theorem has analytic proofs of the exact endpoint, all equality directions, and embedding ranks; computational checks support but do not replace the proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Every asserted affine plane must exist; existence at arbitrary order is not assumed.
Graph vertices are points and lines; all edges have unit length, and all coefficients are real.
No formula for weighted incidence graphs, general designs or continuum graph metrics is claimed.
All-orders proof is algebraic; finite-field calculations are corroborating cases only.
title: Exact negative type and Hilbert-rank transition of finite affine-plane incidence metrics
